# Late Policy

## Summary
Per-day deduction, cap, grace hours and hard close. Pure `latePenalty(policy, dueAt, submittedAt)` returns {daysLate, penaltyPct, closed}; `hardCloseAt()` derives the drop-box close.

## Usage
On Course; read by Submit Assignment (close) and Grade Submission (penalty).

## Non-goals
Does not store the applied penalty — Grade does, as the grader's decision.
